title: Calico private archive transaction manifest (v1)
description: Closed immutable transaction manifest written last -- after every content object and the promotion snapshot -- by calico_capture.archive.synchronize_verified_transaction (06-01-PLAN.md D-01/D-03; 06-RESEARCH.md Pattern 1/2/6). A manifest satisfying this schema is the sole proof a private archive transaction is complete and restorable; content objects existing without a schema-valid manifest at the matching key are never treated as authoritative history.

transaction_id.description: Deterministic identifier derived only from (as_of_date, release_revision, revision_fingerprint) -- a retried synchronize call for the same accepted revision always resolves to this same transaction id, which is what makes replay byte-verified idempotent.

object_keys.description: Every content object key this transaction mirrors, beneath the fixed archive/v1/store/ prefix only -- never a staging, lock, or arbitrary filesystem path. Serialized in stable lexical order (must_haves truth 4).

object_sha256.description: The exact keyed SHA-256 of every object named in object_keys -- the same closed set, one digest per key.
